headline: All optional root fields
summary: Demonstrates optional rank, date_confirmed in any format, sources_confirmed URLs, summary text, and meta. Only headline and sections are required.

items.text: rank is optional — omit it or use 1, 2, 3… to control feed order.
date_confirmed accepts any display format (05-04-2026, 2026-04-05, April 5 2026).
sources_confirmed must list unique strings (often URLs).
meta can include topic, audience, priority, tags, and custom keys.
